title: Don't Waste the Population: Post-Anneal Refinement for Combinatorial Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.33766v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Parallel annealers generate diverse candidate solutions; yet, conventional post-processing typically refines only the best, leaving much of the population's potential untapped. We introduce Iterative Path-Relinking Polish (I-PRP), a deterministic, training-free method that exploits this diversity to discover better solutions without modifying the underlying annealing process. I-PRP selects promising candidates, explores cost-guided paths between locally optimized solutions, and refines intermediate states to uncover better local minima. Newly discovered improvements are iteratively incorporated into the population, enabling further exploration. We theoretically guarantee that I-PRP never degrades solution quality relative to conventional single-candidate polishing on the same population and converges in finitely many iterations. translated_title: 不要浪费种群：面向组合优化的退火后精细化方法
translated_abstract: 并行退火算法能够生成多样化的候选解；然而，传统的后处理通常只对其中最优的解进行精细化，导致种群的很大一部分潜力未被挖掘。我们提出了迭代路径重连精细化，这是一种确定性、无需训练的方法，它利用这种多样性来发现更优的解，而无需修改底层的退火过程。I-PRP 选择有潜力的候选解，在局部优化的解之间探索由成本引导的路径，并对中间状态进行精细化以发现更好的局部极小值。新发现的改进会被迭代地融入种群，从而支持进一步的探索。我们从理论上证明，在相同种群上，I-PRP 相比传统的单候选解精细化方法不会降低解的质量，并且能在有限次迭代内收敛。在包括 MaxCut、MaxClique 和图着色等具有挑战性的组合优化基准测试上的实验表明……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种无需训练的确定性后处理方法 I-PRP，通过在并行退火产生的候选解之间探索成本引导的路径重连并迭代融入新改进，在不修改退火过程的前提下发掘种群多样性，从理论上保证不劣于传统单解精细化且有限收敛，并在 MaxCut、MaxClique 等组合优化基准上发现更优解。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces I-PRP, a deterministic, training-free post-anneal refinement method that exploits population diversity by exploring cost-guided paths between candidate solutions with theoretical guarantees of no quality degradation and finite convergence, yielding better solutions on combinatorial optimization benchmarks such as MaxCut and MaxClique.
